title: Monodromy representations of braid groups and Yang-Baxter equations
note: Proves that monodromy of the Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov connection on the configuration space $X_n$ coincides with the quantum-group R-matrix representation of $U_q(g)$.  Flatness of the KZ connection at generic q is the mathematical content behind the lifted-crossing locality hypothesis in the mass-volume expansion.  PDF library/kohno1987-aif/ — Numdam copy.
